institutional_scope: U.S. District Court, Central District of Illinois

remedy.notes: Order of Chief Judge Sara Darrow, 2 September 2026, the post-judgment sanctions phase following the 24 July 2026 default-judgment order that first identified the citations. The template mechanism is what distinguishes this record: the fabrications were embedded in reusable drafting material rather than produced for one brief. The order cross-references two other matters involving the same attorney, Hippe v. Retention Brands, No. 2:25-cv-00596 (E.D. Wis.) and Pittman v. Hazel & Olive, No. 1:25-cv-07791 (N.D. Ill.), neither of which is in this corpus. The docket’s CourtListener title reflects the stale original caption naming a terminated co-defendant.
